title: Opportunity Analyst Output
description: Deep-dive analysis output consumed by the scoring-agent. TAM/SAM/SOM MUST be emitted as plain numbers in the document's declared `currency` (default USD). Never emit formatted strings like "$100 billion" — the downstream scoring-agent reads these as raw numbers and will assign 0 if it receives strings.

market_size_estimate.description: Market sizing at the document root with numeric TAM/SAM/SOM in the declared `currency`. Methodology strings go in `tam_methodology`/`sam_methodology`/`som_methodology`, NOT mixed into the numeric fields.

tam.description: Total Addressable Market as a plain number in `currency`. Example: 100000000000 for $100B. Do NOT emit "$100 billion" or "100B".

sam.description: Serviceable Available Market as a plain number in `currency`.

som.description: Serviceable Obtainable Market as a plain number in `currency`.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for tam/sam/som. Default USD. Always emit this field so downstream code is not source-dependent.

confidence.description: Confidence in the market sizing estimate, 0..1.
